title: Rights of the Mortgagee of Record Under NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## The mortgagee of record — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

**Mortgage-required policies.** A policy is mortgage-required when a federally regulated lender requires flood coverage as a condition of a loan secured by the building in a Special Flood Hazard Area; the first mortgagee and loan number are shown on the policy.

**Changing the mortgagee.** A Mortgagee Change endorsement replaces the mortgagee of record and the loan number on the date it is recorded, and a mortgagee can be removed only with that mortgagee's written release or a payoff letter.

**Notice on cancellation or non-renewal.** When a mortgage-required policy is cancelled or is not renewed, Tidemark sends written notice to the mortgagee of record on the date the cancellation is processed or the grace period ends; the policy then continues for the benefit of the mortgagee only for the tier's mortgagee protection period, in calendar days, after that notice.

**Claim payees.** Building claim payments are issued jointly to the insured and the mortgagee of record when the tier names the mortgagee on building payments; contents, ICC and loss-avoidance payments go to the insured alone.

| Payment | Payee |
|---|---|
| Building claim payment (tier names the mortgagee on building payments) | The insured and the mortgagee of record jointly |
| Contents payment | The insured alone |
| Increased Cost of Compliance payment | The insured alone |
| Loss-avoidance reimbursement | The insured alone |

| Event on a mortgage-required policy | Notice date | Protection for the mortgagee |
|---|---|---|
| Cancellation processed | The processing date | Continues for the mortgagee only, for the protection period after the notice |
| Grace period ends without renewal | The date the grace period ends | Continues for the mortgagee only, for the protection period after the notice |
